_comment: Composite indexes for the teacher dashboard's submission queries (js/firestore-client.js querySubmissions). Declared here so they are reproducible instead of being created by clicking the link in a FAILED_PRECONDITION error, which is how they were made until now. Each entry pairs one equality/array filter with the orderBy('submittedAt','desc') every query applies. Combinations of several filters at once need their own index and will still surface a console link the first time they are used — that is a deliberate trade: declaring all 16 combinations would cost index storage for queries nobody runs.
